title: Corn in the Dark Barn
lines: Nell and her dad park by the dark barn.
Nell must fill the corn bin in the barn.
It is so dark that she can not see.
First she trips on a jar of corn.
Corn spills all on the barn dirt.
Then birds turn up and pick at the corn.
Nell claps her hands hard, but the birds sit.
The birds want the corn on the dirt.
Nell gets the lamp from her dad.
The girl can see all the corn.
She sorts it back in the jar.
The birds go, and Nell fills the corn bin.

questions.ask: Why did Nell trip on the jar of corn?
questions.listenFor: The barn was so dark she could not see. It is the third line.

questions.ask: What did Nell do to get the birds to go?
questions.listenFor: She got the lamp, then sorted the spilled corn back in the jar. Clapping had not worked.

questions.ask: What did Nell do first in the dark barn? What did she do once she had the lamp?
questions.listenFor: She tripped and spilled the corn, then sorted it back in the jar and filled the bin.
